strings.onb.p1.title: Count the days you've had together
strings.onb.p1.body: Set the date you got together and see which day it is on the home screen.
strings.onb.p2.title: Decorate your room with a prompt
strings.onb.p2.body: Describe the mood you want and see a preview. Apply it only when you like it.
strings.onb.p3.title: Aroomi lives in your room
strings.onb.p3.body: It greets the two of you from a corner of the room.
strings.onb.back.title: Welcome back
strings.onb.back.body: Sign in the way you did last time.
